text:
Alex Chen: Morning — quick async product check. What I did: reviewed latest routing perf numbers and updated the rollout checklist. Blockers: final infra notes from eng-runtime needed for canary config. Today: pair with Jordan on spec edits and unblock the canary.
Maya Patel: ✅ Thanks. FYI PM note: legal asked for a short SSO section in the spec — added comment in the doc. No blocker on product side.
Jordan Lee: On review now. I pushed a tiny change to the schema example — pinging for CR: https://gh.redwood/infr/rdw-123
Samir Gonzalez: Quick heads-up — infra team is trimming GPU pool tonight 02:00 UTC. Canary window needs to avoid that slot. I'll open a maintenance flag.
Priya Desai: UX note: one microcopy change in modal (confirm step) — pushed to the spec doc. No design blocker.
Chris O.: QA: smoke tests for embed cache passed locally, but I saw intermittent timeouts on long-context sequences (100k tokens simulated). Logging attached in thread. Could be kv-cache interaction.
Alex Chen: @Jordan can you check the long-context test? If it's kv-cache related we need an eng-runtime hotfix before canary.
Jordan Lee: Looking into Chris's logs. Repro steps:
```
python tests/load_long_context.py --model redwood-7b --seq 100k
```
I can reproduce the timeout at ~45s when cache eviction spikes. Hypothesis: batching + eviction race.
Samir Gonzalez: If that's true, delaying the canary by 24h is fine. We prefer stability over rushing the rollout.
Maya Patel: Prioritization: Product prefers canary this week but not at cost of flaky QA. If Jordan needs eng-runtime support, Samir — can you allocate a patch reviewer?
Samir Gonzalez: I can spare @deploy-bot to run a debug build and attach traces. Also assigning an on-call from runtime.
Jordan Lee: Thanks — tagging @Samir and I'll post a small repro PR in the morning. CR ping to Samir and Alex when ready.
Alex Chen: Action items: 1) Jordan to open repro PR and CR (today) 2) Samir to schedule debug build & on-call debug window 3) Chris to rerun smoke with debug flags and share traces. If all green, move canary to Thu 10:00 UTC. If not, new plan Thu+48h. :ear_of_rice:
Priya Desai: I'll prepare the support text and rollback UX just in case — will drop in the spec.
Maya Patel: Sounds good. Small reminder: add SSO snippet per legal before Saturday cut.
deploy-bot: maintenance notice queued for 02:00 UTC tonight (GPU pool trim). Reply with `cancel` to abort.
Alex Chen: Thanks all — I'll follow up after Jordan posts the PR. Short updates only after that, please. :thumbsup:
